title: Sunshine Loves My Garden
style: Indie folk ballad featuring a fingerpicked acoustic guitar and a soft male vocal. The guitar plays a steady eighth-note pattern with a bright, resonant tone. The vocals are intimate and close-mic'd with a slight natural reverb. The tempo is 78 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic guitar picking and the melodic vocal line.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[soft male vocals]
Watch them glow in the light
Pickle jars shining bright
In my garden, sun every day
Little sprouts reaching high
Soaking in golden sky
That’s how much the sunshine loves my garden
